"Not optional": the cards print no "may", and Void Mandible prints "(This is not optional.)". Maelstrom Charger is a different shape ("As you play a nonunit spell, you may sacrifice me"), settled by its RAQ write-up: the child rule. The engine makes the sacrifice as the ability resolves since 2026-10-21; 515-trigger-sacrifice-me drives all three cards (source in play while the trigger waits, killed in response does nothing, normal case sacrifices then applies).
